description_en: Queries automatic response rules by paging
description_zh: 分页查询自动响应规则
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-response-rules --next-token AAAAASLVeIxed4466E0LVmGkzwS6hJKd9DGVGMDRM6Lu0000 --max-results 50 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --response-rule-name Send_Notification_When_Generating_Urgent_Incident --response-rule-type custom --response-rule-status 0 --response-action-type doPlaybook --response-trigger-type event --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --role-for 1733260000000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResponseRules

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that marks the current reading position. Leave this parameter empty to read from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to read in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center resides. Select the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.example: Send Notification When Generating Urgent Incident
parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the response rule. Valid values:

preset: predefined
custom: custom
parameters.help_zh:
响应规则类型。

preset：预定义
custom：自定义
parameters.name: response_rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the automatic response rule. Valid values:

0: disabled
100: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则状态。

0：未开启
100：已开启
parameters.name: response_rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The action type of the automatic response rule. Valid values:

doPlaybook: execute a playbook
changeEventStatus: update event status
changeThreatLevel: update event threat level
addEventTag: add an event label
deleteEventTag: delete an event label
alertWhitelist: add alert to whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则动作类型。

doPlaybook：执行剧本
changeEventStatus：更新事件状态
changeThreatLevel：更新事件威胁等级
addEventTag：添加事件标签
deleteEventTag：删除事件标签
alertWhitelist：告警加白
parameters.name: response_action_type

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the automatic response rule. Valid values:

event: event occurred
event_update: event updated
alert: alert occurred
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则触发类型。

event：事件发生
event_update：事件更新
alert：告警发生
parameters.name: response_trigger_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator switches to when viewing from another member's perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the current Alibaba Cloud account view.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type
